newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - April 16.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - April 16.

text.p: (DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker ended higher, supported by rising cargo quotes and healthy enquiries, traders said on Thursday. A 5,000-tonne parcel of 380-cst was reported done at $97.50, up from earlier quotes at between $95-$97. Traders said enquiries emerged later in the day as shipowners emerged to cover their requirements after cargo prices started to rise. "They are just covering before prices rise further," one major said.
